name: x-thread
description: Build an X thread: the first post that sells the whole thing, one idea per post, cut to fit X's weighted character count, and a last post that people act on. Use when the user says "thread", "write a thread", "turn this into a thread", "tweetstorm", or has a list-shaped or step-shaped idea that would be cramped in one post.
